name: carrie-suite
description: Carrie's Web Suite — Book Recommendation Quiz & Pet Certificate Generator

scripts.build: npm run build:books && npm run build:pets && npm run build:portal
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx firebase-tools deploy --project carrie-510519
scripts.deploy:books: npm run build:books && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting:books --project carrie-510519
scripts.deploy:pets: npm run build:pets && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting:pets --project carrie-510519
scripts.deploy:portal: npm run build:portal && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting:portal --project carrie-510519
